title: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse
author: Aesop (trans. V. S. Vernon Jones)
summary: 城里老鼠的盛宴危机四伏，乡下老鼠宁可回家吃简单的饭。
publicDomainBasis: Aesop's fables are ancient; this translation by V. S. Vernon Jones was published in 1912. Public domain in the United States and in China.

paragraphs.en: A Town Mouse and a Country Mouse were acquaintances, and the Country Mouse one day invited his friend to come and see him at his home in the fields. The Town Mouse came, and they sat down to a dinner of barleycorns and roots, the latter of which had a distinctly earthy flavour. The fare was not much to the taste of the guest, and presently he broke out with "My poor dear friend, you live here no better than the ants. Now, you should just see how I fare! My larder is a regular horn of plenty. You must come and stay with me, and I promise you you shall live on the fat of the land."
paragraphs.zh: 城里老鼠和乡下老鼠是熟人。一天，乡下老鼠邀请朋友到他在田野里的家做客。城里老鼠来了，他们坐下来吃大麦粒和草根，那草根有一股明显的泥土味。这饭菜不太合客人的口味，不一会儿他就脱口而出：“我可怜的朋友，你在这里过得还不如蚂蚁。你真该看看我过的是什么日子！我的食品柜简直是个聚宝盆。你一定要来和我住，我保证你能吃香的喝辣的。”

paragraphs.en: So when he returned to town he took the Country Mouse with him, and showed him into a larder containing flour and oatmeal and figs and honey and dates. The Country Mouse had never seen anything like it, and sat down to enjoy the luxuries his friend provided: but before they had well begun, the door of the larder opened and some one came in. The two Mice scampered off and hid themselves in a narrow and exceedingly uncomfortable hole. Presently, when all was quiet, they ventured out again; but some one else came in, and off they scuttled again.
paragraphs.zh: 于是城里老鼠回城时带上了乡下老鼠，把他领进一个食品柜，里面有面粉、燕麦片、无花果、蜂蜜和枣子。乡下老鼠从没见过这样的东西，坐下来享用朋友提供的美味；可他们还没吃上几口，食品柜的门就开了，有人走了进来。两只老鼠慌忙逃窜，躲进一个又窄又难受的洞里。过了一会儿，外面安静了，他们又壮着胆子出来；可又有人进来了，他们再次仓皇逃回。

paragraphs.en: This was too much for the visitor. "Good-bye," said he, "I'm off. You live in the lap of luxury, I can see, but you are surrounded by dangers; whereas at home I can enjoy my simple dinner of roots and corn in peace."
paragraphs.zh: 这对客人来说太过分了。“再见，”他说，“我走了。我看得出，你生活在奢华之中，可你四周都是危险；而在家里，我能安安静静地享用我那顿简单的草根和大麦饭。”
